headline: Iran War Causes Multi-Year Disruption to Strait of Hormuz Oil Flows, Signifying Protracted Global Energy Crisis
summary: Ongoing geopolitical conflict involving Iran is projected to disrupt full oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz until mid-2027, indicating a severe and sustained shock to global energy supply chains. This prolonged energy crisis will significantly escalate operational costs for manufacturing, transportation, AI infrastructure, and semiconductor fabs worldwide, impacting global economic stability.
